  (Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom c₀ T).state = none →
    ∃ t ≤ T,
      (∀ j < t, ¬(Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom c₀ j).Halted) ∧
        Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom c₀ t = Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom c₀ T

∀ (M : Turing.FinTM Bool) (f : ℕ → List Bool) (T : ℕ → ℕ),
  (∀ (n : ℕ), M.ComputesInTime (List.replicate n true) (f n) (T n)) →
    ∃ τ,
      ∀ (x : List Bool),
        τ x.length ≤ T x.length ∧
          (Complexity.b2UnaryTM M).ComputesInTime x (f x.length) (τ x.length) ∧
            ∀ s < τ x.length, (Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Turing.MultiTapeTM.initCfg x) s).state ≠ none

∀ {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (tm : Turing.MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (cfg : Turing.Cfg k Bool S x) (t : ℕ),
  cfg.state ≠ none →
    (Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom cfg t).state = none →
      ∃ u,
        0 < u ∧
          u ≤ t ∧
            (∀ v < u, ¬(Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom cfg v).Halted) ∧
              Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom cfg u = Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom cfg t

∀ {m d kD : ℕ} {Λ SD : Type} {x : List Bool} {l : Λ} {cs : Complexity.LogProg.CallSpec m d Λ} {W : Fin m → List Bool}
  {c0 : Turing.Cfg m Bool Λ x} (P : Complexity.LogProg.RProg m d Λ) (l₀ : Λ) (D : Turing.MultiTapeTM kD Bool SD)
  (q0 : Fin d → SD),
  c0.state = some l →
    P.call l = some cs →
      (∀ r ∈ cs.args, c0.workTapes r = Turing.FinTM.bufferTape (W r)) →
        (∀ r ∈ cs.args, c0.workTapePos r = 0) →
          cs.args.Nodup →
            ↑c0.inputPos = 1 →
              ∀ (b : Bool) (B : ℕ),
                Complexity.LogProg.CleanRun D (q0 cs.dec)
                    (Complexity.LogProg.vword (Complexity.LogProg.callSegs cs x W)) b B →
                  ∃ T,
                    (∀ t ≤ T,
                        (Complexity.LogProg.RegBox cs c0.workTapePos W fun r =>
                            (Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Complexity.LogProg.seam c0) t).workTapePos
                              (Fin.castAdd kD r)) ∧
                          ∀ (i : Fin kD),
                            |(Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Complexity.LogProg.seam c0) t).workTapePos (Fin.natAdd m i)| ≤
                              ↑B) ∧
                      Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Complexity.LogProg.seam c0) T =
                        Complexity.LogProg.seam
                          { state := some (if b = true then cs.yes else cs.no), inputPos := 1,
                            workTapes := c0.workTapes, workTapePos := c0.workTapePos, output := c0.output }

∀ {K : ℕ} {St : Type} {x : List Bool} [inst : Fintype St] (tm : Turing.MultiTapeTM (K + 1) Bool St) (B P T : ℕ),
  (∀ (q : St) (a : Option Bool) (w : Fin (K + 1) → Option Bool),
      ((tm.tr q a w).workTapes (Fin.last K)).1 = none ∨ ((tm.tr q a w).workTapes (Fin.last K)).1 = some (some true)) →
    (Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Turing.MultiTapeTM.initCfg x) T).state = none →
      (∀ t ≤ T,
          (∀ (i : Fin K), |(Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Turing.MultiTapeTM.initCfg x) t).workTapePos i.castSucc| ≤ ↑B) ∧
            |(Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Turing.MultiTapeTM.initCfg x) t).workTapePos (Fin.last K)| ≤ ↑P) →
        Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Turing.MultiTapeTM.initCfg x)
            ((Fintype.card St + 1) * (x.length + 2) * 3 ^ (K * (2 * B + 1)) * (2 * B + 1) ^ K *
              ((2 * P + 1) * (2 * P + 2))) =
          Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Turing.MultiTapeTM.initCfg x) T
